body.heading: Set the stage
paragraphs: Hide behind the sofa or table so only your puppets can be seen. Practise making them pop up and duck down.
Decide the story: two friends, one small problem, one happy ending.

body.heading: Showtime
paragraphs: Invite your audience to sit down. Announce your show in your grandest voice.
Make each puppet sound different, bow at the end, and enjoy the clapping.

takeaway: A sofa, two puppets, and a brave storyteller make a whole theatre.
materials: A sofa or table for a stage
safetyNotes: Let your adult know the show is starting so nobody trips over the stage in the dark.
screenFreeExtension: Draw tickets and a poster for your next show.
